name: Mountain Mesh
area: North Georgia and East Tennessee (Appalachian Mountains), Metro Atlanta, Athens

mqtt.advice: Their configs set OK to MQTT on and Ignore MQTT on.

notes: Mobile hop limit is 5; do not go above 6.
Mobile nodes: device and environment metrics off. Home nodes: device metrics every 3 hours on solar nodes only.
ROUTER_LATE is for coordinated public high sites; talk to them on Discord first.
Optional secondary channel: LongFast, key AQ==.
